       WHEN fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY IS NULL THEN FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(fr_hist.TOTAL_AREA) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY),0)),0)
